task_description: Build the complete PartySwoop application - a real-time party request management system. Guests scan QR codes to request drinks/supplies/songs, hosts see requests with audio alerts and manage menu/locations. Features AI-powered fridge scanning for menu creation, SSE for real-time updates within 3 seconds, and 24-hour party expiry. Built with Next.js 14, PostgreSQL, Prisma, and Tailwind CSS.
